assets.title: The Last Procession — Dominion sacrifice
assets.question: Approved by creator on 2026-11-06.
assets.note: Canon: the depicted Dominion sacrifice/procession scene. Names of participants, location and additional ritual mechanics are not supplied by this approval.
assets.hook: A procession carries fragments of the dead into a hall whose roof has long fallen.
assets.scene: A vast ROOFLESS OLD IMPERIAL OSSUARY in a quiet lavender moor. Broad stone galleries and sunken burial terraces step down into the foreground; a single surviving arch spans empty sky in the far left. The main visual action is a sparse procession of small draped Gravebound figures carrying shallow bowls of gathered bone toward a dark stair, seen at a respectful distance from behind and above. Weathered plain stone and dark cloth, no grotesque exposed corpses. One living human attendant pauses to retrieve a dropped cloth, giving grief and doubt a place in the scene. Pale late winter afternoon, restrained violet and grey with cold straw grasses and one warm clay bowl. Layers of deep space, broad paint and a few precise accents on the stair and hands; patient eerie silence rather than horror spectacle. No skull mountains, green necromantic glow, vampire nobility, battle, lightning or lavish cathedral.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Breachline campaign environment concept painting for a creator review collection. Landscape 1536 x 1024, 3:2, full artwork, high quality.
ART DIRECTION: traditional oil-and-acrylic high fantasy painting; confident visible brushwork, rich but economical detail, believable materials, broad coherent light and shadow. Sharpest accents explain the scene's action; other edges soften into atmosphere. Simple natural faces, varied stroke size, no microscopic pores/teeth/hair, no uniform diagonal texture. Beautiful authored composition, not photorealism, 3D render, anime, comic, vector or cinematic game screenshot. Light organizes the story. Variety of palettes, viewpoint and human scale matters.
SETTING: Earth-like continents, 150 years after the Old Empire collapsed and the high gods went silent. New kingdoms and daily life continue; this is high fantasy, not Bronze Age aesthetic and not a drowned archipelago. Alignments are outlooks shared by diverse peoples, not five racial countries. Humans appear in all. Sunmane lionfolk have believable noble lion heads, upright humanlike bodies; orcs and goblins are people. The Artificers are makers associated with Gnosis. Gods remain mysterious. No scene explains the Cataclysm. No Opaline Kin. No added glowing gold scars or threads unless specifically requested. Truly gigantic animals are rare; do not add them as scenery.
CONSTRAINTS: no text, labels, letters, borders, card frames, signatures, watermark or copied franchise designs. Avoid generic heroic posing, gratuitous gore, ubiquitous ivy, rain or cathedrals. A place can be the main subject with small purposeful inhabitants. Each named place here is a proposed design, not a declaration of canon.
SCENE:
A vast ROOFLESS OLD IMPERIAL OSSUARY in a quiet lavender moor. Broad stone galleries and sunken burial terraces step down into the foreground; a single surviving arch spans empty sky in the far left. Weathered plain stone and dark cloth, no grotesque exposed corpses. One living human attendant pauses to retrieve a dropped cloth, giving grief and doubt a place in the scene. Pale late winter afternoon, restrained violet and grey with cold straw grasses and one warm clay bowl. Layers of deep space, broad paint and a few precise accents on the stair and hands; patient eerie silence rather than horror spectacle. No skull mountains, green necromantic glow, vampire nobility, battle, lightning or lavish cathedral.

assets.title: The Unmeasured Distance
assets.use: Metaphysical visual direction / possible late-game mood
assets.question: Is this degree of abstraction useful for the gods' distance, or should the unseen remain less literal?
assets.note: Canonical visual depiction of the hidden cosmology. Does not establish a successful crossing or character knowledge.
assets.hook: A surviving connection can be real while the distance remains impossible to understand.
assets.scene: EXPERIMENT / CREATOR-ONLY METAPHYSICAL PAINTING. Abstract the distance between mortal world and silent gods WITHOUT revealing any god, primordial creature or physical portal. Bottom left a very small indistinct human summoner stands at the limit of a dark grounded plane, a tiny visible golden scar on the wrist. One impossibly fine gold thread travels into enormous layered regions of pale turquoise, deep ultramarine, wine-violet and warm pearl, disappearing and reappearing across discontinuous painted space. At far upper right a restrained distant warm luminosity has NO palace or humanoid form. The vast gap is primordial chaos portrayed through broad curved and fractured passages of translucent oil colour, not space stars, tentacles or literal storm clouds. Radical asymmetry, enormous quiet intervals, economical marks, beautiful selective luminous glazing and some raw matte strokes. Compared with the existing Across the Silence composition, shift the distant light HIGH and make space feel discontinuous instead of a mountain valley. Melancholy and possible hope, not triumphant successful crossing. No legible diagram, infinity symbols, explanatory text, battle or settled cause of the Cataclysm.
